title: Recover captured ideas in a later session
summary: Keep a dated record of a project idea while its context is fresh so a human or a coding agent can pick it up after a day or two.

origin.source: 2026-11-19 · README HQ Provenistem design discussion and tracker README trial.

benefits: A fresh session can recover why an idea mattered and which capabilities it led to.
risks: An idea recorded without its origin or reasoning may be hard to interpret later.
